history_wall_target.carrier: H_wall with wall set containing 0 and log-prime endpoints

positive_zero_extension.name: J_+
positive_zero_extension.formula: (J_+rho)(t)=0 for t<0 and rho(t) for t>0

intertwining.exact_graph_identity: D_wall J_+ rho=(J_+ partial_r rho, rho(0) delta_0-coordinate)
intertwining.meaning: the apparent failure of zero extension to commute with differentiation is exactly the retained bordered initial-value atom, not an error term

negative_orientation.name: J_-^u
negative_orientation.formula: (J_-^u rho)(t)=u rho(-t) for t<0 and 0 for t>0
negative_orientation.use: the doubled radial operator diag(partial_r,-partial_r) maps by J_+ direct_sum J_-^u into the two oriented history-wall lanes with the declared wall relation

pair_response_application.map: j_H(rho_g)=J_+rho_g, with reciprocal leg J_-^u when retained
pair_response_application.all_jets: zero extension is parameter independent and commutes with every z derivative

remaining_owner_comparison: Adopt the history-wall realization of the conservative history diagonal, or prove that the old D0 block is conjugate to D_wall-z with its explicit wall output. The analytic intertwiner itself is complete.
disposition: The correct dynamic intertwiner is canonical zero extension, not a tensor-range connection. It sends the radial derivative to the broken history differential and turns the radial initial value into the wall jump at zero. Item 3 is analytically closed up to conservative identification of D0.
